text_block_list.text:
Because Biwa Hayahide suffered a major 
injury, practice was paused, and I came to 
bring her luggage, but—

text_block_list.name: School Nurse
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Hayahide-san just left saying 
she's going to the gym...!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa... With this injury... my 
efficiency drops... this much, huh?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Trainer-kun...!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I apologize for acting on my own. 
...However, there is no need to worry 
about injuries.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I've already experienced severe injuries 
as a child. The sheer magnitude of the 
losses that follow... is deeply ingrained 
in me.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
That is precisely why... I must hurry to 
construct the theory.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
We'll put the theory into practice without 
pushing too hard, taking into account how 
injuries reduce efficiency. So—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I beg of you. Do not stop my stride...!
choice_data_list: Let's head back to the nurse's office.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I... see... Am I once again... doomed to 
only... watch their receding backs...?
choice_data_list:
If it gets worse, I won't even be able to 
chase after their back.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: —Kh.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...You're right. I'm sorry... I understand 
it logically, but...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
If I rush, I'll only repeat the mistakes 
of the past. And yet...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
......No, it's nothing. Regardless, I'll 
follow your lead.

Biwa Hayahide desperately suppressed her 
impatience and focused on recuperating...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-kun... Thank you... Now then, let 
us begin at once!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Ah!
(THUMP!)

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"I-I'm fine... I just, caught my foot... 
on something, is all..."

Perhaps unable to shake her anxiety over 
the injury, Biwa Hayahide suffered a new 
one. It looks like it will take some time 
to make a full recovery...

Afterward, I conducted an experiment with 
Biwa Hayahide to put the theory into 
practice...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I... see... Judging from this heart 
rate... Just as theorized, the strain on 
the muscles has decreased—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"Phew... That was time well spent. I 
learned plenty of things beyond just 
theory."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...My weapon is not theory alone. It is 
having someone by my side to examine 
theories with... and elevate one another.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
You too are my weapon, after all... I can 
hardly wait for training to resume.
